description.value: Tofino Waves and Tacos is an authentic Mexican restaurant founded by Magdalena, who spent over a decade in Tofino before opening the spot to share the flavours of her home region of Veracruz. The menu centres on tacos, quesadillas, and tostadas made with house sauces and slow-cooked meats, with most items available on gluten-free corn tortillas. It is an independent, locally owned restaurant and a genuine find for cyclists looking for a satisfying hot meal in Tofino.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at wavesandtacos.com is clearly for 'Tofino Waves and Tacos,' an authentic Mexican restaurant — not a coffee house as OSM names it; the OSM name, brand, and amenity=cafe tags appear to be misattributed from the Waves Coffee House chain. The address 220 Campbell St, Tofino, BC V0R 2Z0 is confirmed by the website. Takeout is confirmed by OSM takeaway=yes and the takeout-format menu; gluten-free is confirmed by repeated 'corn tortillas (gluten free)' notations throughout the menu.
concerns: OSM name 'Waves Coffee House' does not match the actual business name 'Tofino Waves and Tacos' as shown on the website. The OSM brand tag (Waves Coffee House, wikidata Q114096538) and amenity=cafe appear to be misattributed from the unrelated Waves Coffee House chain. The OSM 'branch: & Tacos' tag hints at a confused merge of two different businesses. OSM record should be corrected to amenity=restaurant with name 'Tofino Waves and Tacos'.
No phone number available in OSM or on the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating Mexican restaurant in Tofino with an active website, confirmed address, and current menu. A useful food stop for touring cyclists.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Multiple menu items explicitly labelled 'corn tortillas (gluten free)' — El Clasico, Beef in Adobo, Pork en Green, Green & Adobo tacos, and several quesadillas and tostadas. No explicitly vegetarian or vegan dishes identified on the website
